# Sodium properties and operating conditions

Source papers: `Bourgoin2002`, `Monchaux2007`, `Monchaux2009`.

| Quantity | Symbol | Value | Unit | Source / notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Density | rho | 929 | kg m^-3 | Monchaux2009; Bourgoin2002 uses 930 |
| Dynamic viscosity | mu | 6.9e-4 | Pa s | Monchaux2007, about 120 C |
| Kinematic viscosity | nu | 7.4e-7 | m^2 s^-1 | Monchaux2007 |
| Electrical conductivity | sigma(T) | 108/(6.225+0.0345 T) | S m^-1 | Monchaux2009, Eq. (1), T in C |
| Thermal conductivity | lambda | 85 | W m^-1 K^-1 | Monchaux2007 |
| Specific heat | Cp | 1380 | J kg^-1 K^-1 | Monchaux2007 |
| Magnetic diffusivity | eta | 0.078 | m^2 s^-1 | Monchaux2007 |
| Magnetic Prandtl number | Pm | 1e-5 | - | Monchaux2009 |
| Operating temperature | T_op | 110-160 | deg C | Monchaux2009 |
| Impeller efficiency | K | 0.6 | - | Monchaux2009; 0.7 for opposite rotation direction |
| Maximum impeller frequency | F_max | 27 | Hz | Monchaux2009 |
| Maximum Rm | Rm_max | 49 | - | Monchaux2009 (52 in Ravelet2008) |
| Maximum Re | Re_max | 5e6 | - | Monchaux2009 |

At 120 C, sigma is approximately 1.03e7 S m^-1.

quantities.location: Sec. I.B: density rho approx. 930 kg m^-3
quantities.notes: Bourgoin2002 uses 930 kg m^-3 in dimensionless groups; value varies with temperature.

quantities.location: Sec. I.B / properties table: mu = 6.9e-4 Pa s at about 120 C
quantities.notes: Temperature-dependent; Bourgoin2002 reports a similar value for the operating range.

quantities.location: Properties table: nu approx. 7.4e-7 m^2 s^-1
quantities.notes: Consistent with rho and mu at the reference temperature.
T in degrees Celsius; valid for T in [100, 200] C. Example: sigma(120 C) approx. 1.03e7 S m^-1.
Used in the thermal property table of PLAN_vks.md.
Used in the thermal property table of PLAN_vks.md.

quantities.location: Properties table: eta = 1/(mu0 sigma) approx. 0.078 m^2 s^-1
quantities.notes: Molecular magnetic diffusivity; turbulent effective diffusivity is separate.

quantities.location: Sec. I.B: Pm about 1e-5 for sodium
quantities.notes: Ratio of kinematic viscosity to magnetic diffusivity.

quantities.location: Sec. I.B: regulated temperature range 110-160 C
quantities.notes: Bourgoin2002 reports operation in 130-170 C for the earlier device.

quantities.location: Sec. I.C: K = 0.6 for exact counter-rotation
quantities.notes: Used in Re = K 2 pi R_c^2 F / nu and Rm = K mu0 sigma 2 pi R_c^2 F. For opposite rotation direction Monchaux2009 uses K_- = 0.7.

quantities.location: Sec. I.C: impellers driven up to typically 27 Hz
Sec. I.C: maximum Rm = 49 at 120 C
quantities.notes: Ravelet2008 reports Rm up to 52 at 120 C with a slightly different convention.

quantities.location: Sec. I.C: Re can be increased up to 5e6
quantities.notes: Integral Reynolds number based on impeller frequency.
